_readme: Human-curated merges for the gazetteer. Each key is a canonical English name; its list holds other spellings in the route text that mean the same place. Matching uses the pipeline's normalised keys, so case, dots, 'No.' and generic words like Chowrangi/Chourangi don't need listing. Review build/review.md for candidates, add a line here, re-run the pipeline. Only merge when you are sure: two places merged wrongly create fake transfers. The initial entries were seeded by Claude from obvious spelling variants and still need a human check.
_routeOverridesReadme: Per-route renames, for generic names that mean a different place on a particular route. Key = route code (or 'code#n' for duplicate codes, see build/routes.json), value = { 'name as written in the text': 'place name to use' }.
